This page is organized by research method rather than repository. Registry labels and installation commands are shown at the implementation level. Forked repositories are linked to their upstream authors so implementation credit remains explicit.

## summclust {#summclust}

Cluster-level leverage and influence diagnostics and cluster-jackknife variance estimation for linear regression models.

### Implementations

::: {.implementation}
#### summclust — Stata <span class="registry-pill">SSC</span>

**Implementation:** Matthew D. Webb<br>
**Role:** Original implementation

[SSC](https://ideas.repec.org/c/boc/bocode/s459072.html) · [GitHub](https://github.com/mattdwebb/summclust) · [Documentation](https://github.com/mattdwebb/summclust/blob/main/summclust.sthlp)

**Install**

```stata
ssc install summclust
```
:::

### Associated paper

[MacKinnon, James G., Morten Ørregaard Nielsen, and Matthew D. Webb. 2023. 'Leverage, Influence, and the Jackknife in Clustered Regression Models: Reliable Inference Using summclust.' Stata Journal 23(4): 942-982.](https://www.econ.queensu.ca/research/working-papers/1483)

### How to cite

Please cite the associated Stata Journal article when the method or software contributes to published research.

## logitjack {#logitjack}

Cluster-jackknife and wild-cluster-bootstrap inference for logistic regression models.

### Implementations

::: {.implementation}
#### logitjack — Stata <span class="registry-pill">SSC</span>

**Implementation:** Matthew D. Webb<br>
**Role:** Original implementation

[SSC](https://ideas.repec.org/c/boc/bocode/s459337.html) · [GitHub](https://github.com/mattdwebb/logitjack) · [Documentation](https://github.com/mattdwebb/logitjack/blob/main/logitjack.sthlp)

**Install**

```stata
ssc install logitjack
```
:::

### Associated paper

[MacKinnon, James G., Morten Ørregaard Nielsen, and Matthew D. Webb. 'Cluster-Robust Jackknife and Bootstrap Inference for Binary Response Models.' Forthcoming, Econometric Reviews.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.00650)

### How to cite

Please cite the associated Econometric Reviews article; the SSC record also provides a software citation.

## twowayjack {#twowayjack}

Jackknife variance estimation and inference for linear regression models with two-way clustering.

[Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9UorOgryxzc)

### Implementations

::: {.implementation}
#### twowayjack — Stata <span class="registry-pill">GitHub only</span>

**Implementation:** Matthew D. Webb<br>
**Role:** Original implementation

[GitHub](https://github.com/mattdwebb/twowayjack) · [Documentation](https://github.com/mattdwebb/twowayjack/blob/main/twowayjack.sthlp)

**Install**

```stata
net install twowayjack, from("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mattdwebb/twowayjack/main/") replace
```
:::

### Associated paper

[MacKinnon, James G., Morten Ørregaard Nielsen, and Matthew D. Webb. 2024. 'Jackknife Inference with Two-Way Clustering.' arXiv:2406.08880.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.08880)

### How to cite

Please cite the associated paper when using the method or implementation.

## CSDID cluster-jackknife inference {#csdid-jackknife}

Cluster-jackknife (CV3) inference for the Callaway-Sant'Anna difference-in-differences estimator.

[Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8xLv7Bu-_l0)

### Implementations

::: {.implementation}
#### csdidjack — Stata <span class="registry-pill">GitHub only</span>

**Implementation:** Yunhan Liu<br>
**Role:** Stata implementation by a research assistant

[GitHub](https://github.com/liu-yunhan/csdidjack) · [Documentation](https://github.com/liu-yunhan/csdidjack#readme)

**Install**

```stata
net install csdidjack, from("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liu-yunhan/csdidjack/main/") replace
```
:::

::: {.implementation}
#### didjack — R <span class="registry-pill">GitHub only</span>

**Implementation:** Yunhan Liu<br>
**Role:** R implementation by a research assistant

[GitHub](https://github.com/liu-yunhan/didjack) · [Documentation](https://github.com/liu-yunhan/didjack#readme)

**Install**

```r
remotes::install_github("liu-yunhan/didjack")
```
:::

### Associated paper

[Karim, Sunny R., Morten Ørregaard Nielsen, James G. MacKinnon, and Matthew D. Webb. 2026. 'Improved Inference for CSDID Using the Cluster Jackknife.' arXiv:2602.12043.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12043)

### How to cite

Please cite the associated paper. Implementation credit belongs to Yunhan Liu, not Matthew Webb.

## DID-INT {#did-int}

Intersection Difference-in-Differences estimation for settings in which covariate effects may vary across states, time, or both.

### Implementations

::: {.implementation}
#### DiDInt.jl — Julia <span class="registry-pill">Julia General Registry</span>

**Implementation:** Eric Jamieson<br>
**Role:** Julia implementation by a research assistant

[Julia General Registry](https://github.com/JuliaRegistries/General/tree/master/D/DiDInt) · [GitHub](https://github.com/ebjamieson97/DiDInt.jl) · [Documentation](https://github.com/ebjamieson97/DiDInt.jl#readme)

**Install**

```julia
using Pkg
Pkg.add("DiDInt")
```
:::

### Associated paper

[Karim, Sunny, and Matthew D. Webb. 2024. 'Good Controls Gone Bad: Difference-in-Differences with Covariates.' arXiv:2412.14447.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.14447)

### How to cite

Please cite the associated paper. The Julia implementation was written by Eric Jamieson.

## UN-DID {#un-did}

Difference-in-differences for data held in separate silos that cannot be pooled, with implementations for four programming languages.

### Implementations

::: {.implementation}
#### undid — Stata <span class="registry-pill">SSC</span>

**Implementation:** Eric Jamieson<br>
**Role:** Stata implementation by a research assistant

[SSC](https://ideas.repec.org/c/boc/bocode/s459516.html) · [GitHub](https://github.com/ebjamieson97/undid) · [Documentation](https://github.com/ebjamieson97/undid#readme)

**Install**

```stata
ssc install undid
```
:::

::: {.implementation}
#### undidR — R <span class="registry-pill">CRAN</span>

**Implementation:** Eric Jamieson<br>
**Role:** R implementation by a research assistant

[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=undidR) · [GitHub](https://github.com/ebjamieson97/undidR) · [Documentation](https://ebjamieson97.github.io/undidR/)

**Install**

```r
install.packages("undidR")
```
:::

::: {.implementation}
#### Undid.jl — Julia <span class="registry-pill">GitHub only</span>

**Implementation:** Eric Jamieson<br>
**Role:** Julia implementation by a research assistant

[GitHub](https://github.com/ebjamieson97/Undid.jl) · [Documentation](https://github.com/ebjamieson97/Undid.jl#readme)

**Install**

```julia
using Pkg
Pkg.add(url="https://github.com/ebjamieson97/Undid.jl")
```
:::

::: {.implementation}
#### undidPyjl — Python <span class="registry-pill">PyPI</span>

**Implementation:** Eric Jamieson<br>
**Role:** Python wrapper by a research assistant

[PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/undidPyjl/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/ebjamieson97/undidPyjl) · [Documentation](https://github.com/ebjamieson97/undidPyjl#readme)

**Install**

```bash
pip install undidPyjl
```
:::

### Associated paper

[Karim, Sunny, Nichole Austin, Erin Strumpf, and Matthew D. Webb. 2025. 'Difference-in-Differences with Unpoolable Data.' arXiv:2403.15910.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.15910)

### How to cite

Please cite the underlying UN-DID paper. All listed language implementations were written by Eric Jamieson.
